body:
Started the night drinking heavily, after around 9 beers I decried to sniff two hydro 4mg. As soon as I lifted my head from the table, it was one of the best rushes I've ever experienced. Opiates usually pick me up which most of my friends say is weird. But I was worried about getting nausiated, but had no bad reactions at all, but I've pretty much always had a high tolerance to opiates. It there my drunkenness into an amazing feeling that ill never forget. No nod, and no tiredness.
Very fun and great feeling. I couldn't stop rambling, and had an amazing high mixed with the alcohol.
